description: Pre-render checks of a project: page errors, determinism, text off-canvas or overlapping, contrast, readability, dead air, fonts. Lists problems with timestamps and fixes, plus a contact sheet path.

background.description: answer at once with a task id and keep working in the background; the status tool with {"task": id} reports progress and the result. Default false: wait for the result (a host with a short tool-call limit gets a task id after about 20 s anyway).

name: check
title: Check a project before rendering
